note: Research projects whose technologies are never linked to Hindsight subjects (D52). snapshot.mjs leaves their technologies out of technologies-snapshot.json and candidates.mjs never proposes them; any link row to one is retracted. Remove an entry only by a new decision.

projects.reason: Xenotech presents alleged UAP and exotic technology under plain technology titles (xenotech/arts-parts-metamaterials, titled "Metamaterials", is about alleged Roswell samples), so title and embedding matches against real technologies mislead.

Subspace catalogues science-fiction technologies (Star Trek: Medical Tricorder, Universal Translator, Genesis Device, Replicator) under plain technology titles, so title and embedding matches against real technologies mislead (subspace/medical-tricorder, the fictional device, was linked same to the medical-tricorder subject in d48-r0).
